summary: Iteration 5 validates the WhatsApp click-to-chat checkout flow end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 new tests + 6/6 regression pass (menu = 57 items, idempotent seed, UPI config disabled shape, CORS preflight ACAO header, orders persist event_datetime/utr/payment_method with proper defaults). Frontend: customer login -> add 2 dishes from /just-hungry -> /checkout renders all required fields (name/phone/email/event/address/instructions/UPI box/UTR/send-whatsapp/pay-online). Missing event_date submission shows checkout-error and does NOT create order. Full submission with UTR123 creates order NV-D7854ACA, wa.me href contains order id, name, phone, 'Event:' line, venue, each item, Subtotal/Delivery/Total and 'UPI / QR · Txn ID UTR123'. Cart pill -> 0. Receipt modal shows receipt-event and 'UPI / QR · UTR123'. Admin orders row shows event date and payment label; kitchen slip opens with event line. Mobile 390px checkout: no horizontal overflow, WA button fully visible.

minor.issue: test_payments_and_email.py has 3 stale tests assuming Razorpay is disabled, but rzp_test_Tag69UgsTucedr is now set in .env so those endpoints return 200/404 instead of 503. Not a product bug — update stale tests.

action_items: (Optional) Refresh /app/backend/tests/test_payments_and_email.py — the 3 disabled-Razorpay assertions no longer match the enabled test key in backend/.env.

(Nit) The initial window.open('','_blank') pre-navigation gets stripped by wa.me redirect so the emoji shows as replacement char in the very first URL seen by Playwright; user-visible confirmation-whatsapp-button href is correct with emoji. No fix needed unless owner reports it.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.valid() only shows the friendly checkout-error when required HTML attrs are bypassed. With required in place the browser blocks submit and no message appears — acceptable but consider mirroring the JS validation message next to the invalid field for consistency.

sendViaWhatsApp opens window.open('','_blank') before awaiting createOrder; if the POST throws (e.g. network) the empty tab is only closed inside the catch. If the user closes the tab mid-request the reference becomes null-safe (guarded).
orderMessage prints 'Delivery: Free' as text but the receipt shows ₹0 — minor inconsistency, both are readable.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 relevant; 3 stale Razorpay tests unrelated to this iteration)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (checkout WhatsApp + receipt + admin slip + mobile viewport)
